propositions: The _MODEL_ID_CAPABILITY_OVERRIDES table is incomplete: it lists only us.anthropic.claude-opus-4-7 but not us.anthropic.claude-opus-4-8, which is rebar's DEFAULT_MODEL, leaving it unguarded against temperature rejection.

Both global.* and us.* prefixes of claude-opus-4-8 and claude-opus-4-7 reject temperature and top_p parameters (not unsupported, but deprecated for explicit non-default values), yet the override table keys on full model id and covers only one prefix variant.

The Anthropic provider path (anthropic:claude-opus-4-8) also rejects temperature but the override table only covered Bedrock-prefixed ids, causing silent parameter drop with warnings instead of wire errors.

Greedy Pass-2 verification pins temperature=0 for determinism but receives resampling instead when code-review runs all passes on claude-opus-4-8 (which has no verifier downgrade), introducing nondeterminism into review decisions.

temperature=1.0 (API default) succeeds on opus-4-8 while 0.0 and 0.5 fail, indicating the parameter is tunability-deprecated rather than wholly unsupported, and field name supports_temperature misdescribes the mechanism.
